findings.detail: Runs SIRIUS CANOPUS on spectra to output ClassyFire and NPClassifier classes for features and families, but does not output the molecular formulas also required by the stage.
Constructs an MS2 similarity network from differential features, which is the upstream network operation rather than consolidation of annotations into a master table.
Generates a per-feature consensus class table from GNPS, library, and CANOPUS evidence but does not include every requested family and propagated identity field.
Detects and aligns LC-MS/MS features and builds an MS2LDA fragment matrix, but does not produce both GNPS-FBMN and SIRIUS MGF exports.
Maps known node structures to ClassyFire and computes family-level class consensus scores, but does not transfer analogue identities to unannotated neighbours.
